title: TAP Passport claims
description:
The claim set of a TAP Passport — a short-lived compact JWS asserting an agent instance's identity and authorized scope. Normative definition: TAP-spec-v0.1.md §5.

The JOSE header is NOT described here; it is fixed at {"alg":"EdDSA","typ":"tap-passport+jwt","kid":"..."} and a Verifier MUST reject any other `typ` [TAP-PASSPORT-HEADER].

Validating this schema is necessary but nowhere near sufficient: a Passport is authoritative only after its signature, freshness and revocation checks pass [TAP-PASSPORT-VALIDATE].

iss.description: Issuer; the JWKS origin used to resolve `kid`.

iat.description: Issued-at, epoch seconds. Also the timestamp compared against a key's revoked_at [TAP-KEY-REVOCATION].

exp.description: Expiry. Default TTL SHOULD be <= 3600 s; acceptance is iat-60 <= now < exp+60.

jti.description: Unique passport id, sortable. Its uniqueness is one of the two replay guarantees [TAP-REPLAY].

aid.description: Agent instance id, unique per record.

cid.description: Context id binding every Event of this record. Opaque to a Verifier, which never recomputes it.

scope.description: Authorized capabilities as "<verb>:<resource>". Matched by EXACT string equality — no wildcards, no prefixes [TAP-SCOPE-MATCH].

prev_jti.description: OPTIONAL — predecessor on renewal. Scope MUST be a subset of the predecessor's: authority may narrow, never widen [TAP-PASSPORT-LIFECYCLE].

meta.description: OPTIONAL, non-authoritative context (framework, model, agent_name). NEVER trusted for a security decision.
